items.title: Duality for compactly supported pushforward: the lower shriek is left adjoint to the upper shriek in the pro category
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: In Situation labelled situation-shriek, for a morphism f : X -> Y of FTS_S, the proposition asserts that Rf_! and f^! are adjoint in the sense that Hom_X(K, f^!L) = Hom_{Pro-D^+_Coh(O_Y)}(Rf_!K, L), bifunctorially in K in D^b_Coh(O_X) and L in D^+_Coh(O_Y) (statement lines 8720-8758). The proof chooses a compactification j : X -> Xbar over Y with structural morphism fbar, and computes a four term chain: Hom_X(K, f^!L) = Hom_X(K, j^*fbar^!L) by the construction of f^! in Section labelled section-upper-shriek; = Hom_{Pro-D^+_Coh(O_Xbar)}(Rj_!K, fbar^!L) using that fbar^!L lies in D^+_Coh by Lemma labelled lemma-shriek-coherent and the lifting lemma Lemma labelled lemma-lift-map-plus; = Hom_{Pro-D^+_Coh(O_Y)}(Rf_*Rj_!K, L) because fbar is proper so fbar^! is the right adjoint of pushforward by construction; and = Hom_{Pro-D^+_Coh(O_Y)}(Rf_!K, L) since Rf_! = Rf_* o Rj_! (proof lines 8760-8776). Recognising the compactification description of f^! and the pro-category lifting statement as exactly the two ingredients of the adjunction is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
